title: OpenAI and Broadcom to deploy 10 GW of OpenAI-designed accelerators

sources.quote: OpenAI and Broadcom announce strategic collaboration to deploy 10 gigawatts of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators
The two companies have signed a term sheet to deploy racks incorporating the AI accelerators and Broadcom networking solutions.

explain: OpenAI designs its own AI chips and Broadcom builds and delivers them in full server racks with Broadcom networking, 10 gigawatts' worth from late 2026 through 2029. The deal is a signed term sheet and no price was disclosed.
